questionnaire.title: ESG & Sustainability Leadership Role Profile
questionnaire.description: Role requirements for sustainability and ESG leadership positions including CSOs, Heads of ESG, Sustainability Managers, and ESG Controllers across all sectors. Define required competencies for carbon management, climate risk, biodiversity, social impact, ESG governance, reporting frameworks, and stakeholder engagement. Sector-agnostic design for hiring managers.

1.label: Nice to Have
1.description: Beneficial but not essential; no gaps acceptable at interview

2.label: Important
2.description: Expected competency; gaps need development plan

4.label: Essential
4.description: Must have from day one; no gaps acceptable
